layman_headline: Market fear is elevated and altcoins are bleeding — no safe swing trade setup right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful state with the Fear and Greed Index at 27 and trending worse. Bitcoin is down about 2% this week while most altcoins are down even more — some like HYPE and RAIN have dropped 10-12%. A major cold-wallet hack affecting 4,500 Bitcoin addresses is adding to negative sentiment. The few coins showing oversold signals (like BONK) also have terrible chart structures, making them too risky to catch a falling knife on.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market hasn't shown a clear bottom signal yet, and trying to buy during sustained fear without a strong reversal pattern is how traders get caught in further declines. Watch for the Fear and Greed Index to stabilize or improve before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all 7 swing candidates systematically. BONK has the most oversold RSI (29.35) — historically our most reliable signal at 71% win rate — but its chart bias is -1.4 (strongly bearish) with a bearish engulfing candle and -26.5% 5-day momentum, meaning the oversold reading reflects genuine selling pressure rather than a bounce setup. PEPE (RSI 35) has a less bearish chart (-0.7) with a neutral doji candle, which is more promising, but the risk/reward calculation in the chart data appears corrupted. KAITO has the only bullish chart (+1.1) but RSI is 87 — extremely overbought — making it a sell candidate, not a buy. FET has a decent RSI (38) and a -9.6% weekly pullback but a -1.4 bearish chart with bearish engulfing. ENA is strongly bearish (-1.7 chart) with an evening star reversal. With Fear & Greed at 27 and worsening, BTC dominance at 56.3% crushing alts, and no candidate offering both oversold RSI AND bullish chart confirmation, the correct move per my validated rules is to hold cash.

Fear & Greed Index — a move back above 35 would signal fear is abating and improve odds for any entry
ADA momentum — +13.7% weekly with high volume ($628M) in a down market is notable; watch if it pulls back to offer a swing entry

context_banner: Sustained market fear with no confirmed reversal signals — patience over action until a clean setup emerges.
